audit.why: 49.64% over 1241 games, EVEN 5.5/10, and the chart (Renekton 1-5, Skill at 6, Locke at first item, Skill late) matches the packet row for row in both layers.
audit.corrected: No chart change; the whys[] attached to rows 4 and 5 were describing the wrong stages — see point 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] are shifted one row. Row 4 is Level 6 but whys[4] says 'At 5 it evens'; row 5 is First item but whys[5] explains the level-6 Purgatory spike.
audit.why: Those two rows are the only stages that swing in Locke's favour, and both explanations were pointing at the wrong level — the reader is told the item row is about an ultimate they got two stages ago.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now explains Level 6 (Purgatory after his combo dump), whys[5] the first-item Lich Bane spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states what Fury actually changes, and it invents 'both Slice-and-Dice charges' / 'both E charges' — the kit gives Slice and Dice as one dash on 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, with no charge count. Empowered Ruthless Predator's real effects are missing entirely.
audit.why: Over 50 Fury his W stuns for 1.5 seconds instead of 0.75 AND destroys damage shields on the target. That is the difference between surviving the stun with your blink and dying inside it, and it is the reason a shield item does nothing for you on a full bar. The invented charge count also tells the player to wait for a second resource that does not exist.

audit.why: His W is 16s at rank 1 and his dash 16s at rank 1, against your flat 10s blink — after he commits both you own the next six seconds.

notes: Two things I left alone on purpose. Renekton's passive generates Fury FASTER when he is low on health, which cuts against the standard Locke line of 'poke him under half and fight there' — but the kit does not quantify it, so I did not rewrite the win condition around it. Worth the user's judgement. Also, the shield-destruction on empowered W matters for item advice: report[8].t recommends nothing shield-based here, so no edit was needed, but if a shield item is ever added to this page it should be flagged as dead weight into a full Fury bar.
